host.title: Host name
host.description: Fully qualified domain name for Odoo, like 'odoo.example.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA time zone for the container OS, like 'Europe/Berlin'.

workers.title: Worker processes
workers.description: 0 keeps Odoo in threaded mode (one HTTP port, live chat works, one route). A positive value switches to multiprocess.

list_db.title: Show the database manager
list_db.description: Expose the database list and manager (still protected by the master password).

master_password.title: Master password
master_password.description: Odoo master password protecting the database manager (create/duplicate/drop/backup/restore). Leave empty to keep the current one.

ldap_enabled.title: Enable directory login
ldap_enabled.description: Store LDAP/AD settings and let you apply them to a database.

ldap_server.title: LDAP server
ldap_server.description: Host name of the directory server, e.g. ad.example.org.

ldap_tls.title: StartTLS
ldap_tls.description: Use StartTLS on the connection. For Active Directory keep port 389 and StartTLS on (AD refuses plain 389).

ldap_password.title: Bind password
ldap_password.description: Leave empty to keep the stored one.

ldap_create_user.title: Create Odoo users on first login

ldap_verify_cert.title: Verify TLS certificate
ldap_verify_cert.description: Off (default) skips certificate verification, for an internal-CA AD/LDAP; the StartTLS connection stays encrypted. On requires the CA in the trust store.
